name: shamela-mcp
description: MCP server exposing shamela.ws (Islamic digital library) as a set of tools: browse categories/authors, read book pages, and run full-text search.

scripts.build: node --check server.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/tools.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check server.mjs && for file in src/*.mjs src/lib/*.mjs src/data/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs scripts/lib/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
